name: yoinker
description: Explain unfamiliar tools and ideas, test what transfers to a real situation, and decide what to borrow, try, track, or reject.

interface.longDescription: Explain unfamiliar tools and ideas, check their mechanisms against local context, and decide what to borrow, try, track, or reject.
defaultPrompt: Assess this repository and tell me what, if anything, should transfer.
Explain what this tool does and separate evidence from inference.
Compare these approaches against this project's actual constraints.
